message.reasoning_content: Round 5 of 6. Round 6 start: cash devalued to floor(cash/100)*62, promissory added then paid (only last round it's not redeemed — actually after last round promissory not redeemed). So sell_credit in round 5 gives 62%? No: round 6 start cash devalues 62%, promissory added in full. So selling credit now is great: promissory survives devaluation and is added in round 6. But there is no round after 6... promissory after round 6 not redeemed — but we're in round 5, promissory added at round 6 start, then market 6 to sell. So credit sale good: sell_credit units 3 gives promissory 38.75M added fully to cash at round 6 start while rivals' cash devalues 62%. Rivals: 25.2M→15.6M, 23.1M→14.3M. Me: 22.5M→13.95M + 38.75M = 52.7M. Strong lead. Choose 6.
